population_zh: 普通成人或临床人群。
population_en: Adults in general or clinical populations.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 较高心肺适能，或能够提高心肺适能的运动/康复干预。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Higher measured cardiorespiratory fitness or interventions that improve CRF.
comparator_zh: 较低心肺适能、缺乏运动或常规照护。
comparator_en: Lower CRF, inactive control, or usual care.
outcomes_zh: 全因死亡、心血管死亡、功能能力。
outcomes_en: All-cause mortality, cardiovascular mortality, functional capacity.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; large RCT; large prospective cohort; Mendelian randomization where appropriate
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把总体关联直接写成任何个体都适合高强度训练；运动处方需考虑疾病、年龄和风险。

population_zh: 不同年龄段成人。
population_en: Adults across age groups.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 规律身体活动，尤其是中高强度活动和减少久坐。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Regular physical activity, especially moderate-to-vigorous activity and reduced sedentary time.
comparator_zh: 低活动量或久坐行为。
comparator_en: Lower activity or sedentary behavior.
outcomes_zh: 死亡、心血管疾病、糖尿病、功能、衰弱。
outcomes_en: Mortality, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, function, frailty.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; large RCT; large prospective cohort; Mendelian randomization where appropriate
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把它写成单一万能运动处方，也不能忽略伤病和基础疾病。

population_zh: 成人，尤其是老年人或肌少/衰弱风险人群。
population_en: Adults, especially older adults or people at risk of sarcopenia/frailty.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 抗阻训练、力量训练和保肌干预。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Resistance training, strength training, muscle-preserving interventions.
comparator_zh: 无抗阻训练、常规照护或较低训练暴露。
comparator_en: No resistance training, usual care, or lower training exposure.
outcomes_zh: 力量、肌肉量、身体功能、跌倒、衰弱。
outcomes_en: Strength, muscle mass, physical function, falls, frailty.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; large RCT; large prospective cohort; Mendelian randomization where appropriate
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能保证每个人增肌或逆转衰弱；高龄、骨质疏松和慢病人群需评估。

population_zh: 血压正常、升高或高血压成人。
population_en: Adults with normal, elevated, or hypertensive blood pressure.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 血压监测、生活方式管理和循证降压治疗。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Blood pressure monitoring, lifestyle management, and evidence-based antihypertensive treatment.
comparator_zh: 未治疗或控制较差的血压。
comparator_en: Untreated or less controlled blood pressure.
outcomes_zh: 卒中、心血管事件、肾脏结局、死亡。
outcomes_en: Stroke, cardiovascular events, kidney outcomes, mortality.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; large RCT; large prospective cohort; Mendelian randomization where appropriate
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能在图谱中给个人药物选择或剂量；治疗目标需医生决定。

population_zh: 不同 ASCVD 风险、血脂异常、糖尿病或已确诊心血管病成人。
population_en: Adults with varying ASCVD risk, dyslipidemia, diabetes, or established cardiovascular disease.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 降低 LDL-C/apoB 暴露或降脂治疗。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Lower LDL-C/apoB exposure or lipid-lowering treatment.
comparator_zh: 较高 LDL-C/apoB 暴露或较弱管理。
comparator_en: Higher LDL-C/apoB exposure or less intensive management.
outcomes_zh: ASCVD 事件、心梗、卒中、心血管死亡。
outcomes_en: ASCVD events, myocardial infarction, stroke, cardiovascular mortality.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; large RCT; large prospective cohort; Mendelian randomization where appropriate
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能替代个体化风险分层和处方；过低/过高治疗强度都需医生判断。

population_zh: 普通成人或心代谢风险人群。
population_en: Adults in general population or cardiometabolic risk groups.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 地中海/DASH 等健康饮食模式或更高饮食质量。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Healthy dietary patterns such as Mediterranean/DASH-style patterns or higher diet quality.
comparator_zh: 较低饮食质量、超加工或不健康饮食模式。
comparator_en: Lower diet quality, ultra-processed or less healthy patterns.
outcomes_zh: 死亡、心血管疾病、糖尿病、体重和代谢指标。
outcomes_en: Mortality, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, weight and metabolic markers.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; large RCT; large prospective cohort; Mendelian randomization where appropriate
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能神化单一食物、超级食物或补剂，也不能给出个人治疗饮食。

population_zh: 睡眠正常、短睡/长睡、失眠症状或睡眠呼吸障碍风险成人。
population_en: Adults with normal sleep, short/long sleep, insomnia symptoms, or sleep-disordered breathing risk.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 改善睡眠时长/质量，识别和治疗睡眠障碍。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Sleep duration/quality improvement, sleep disorder identification and treatment.
comparator_zh: 睡眠差、未治疗睡眠障碍或睡眠节律不规律。
comparator_en: Poor sleep, untreated sleep disorder, or irregular sleep patterns.
outcomes_zh: 死亡、心代谢结局、认知、心理健康、日间功能。
outcomes_en: Mortality, cardiometabolic outcomes, cognition, mental health, daytime function.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; large RCT; large prospective cohort; Mendelian randomization where appropriate
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把睡眠关联直接写成某种补剂或单一技巧能延寿。

title_en: GLP-1, Weight Loss, and Cardiometabolic Outcomes
population_zh: 肥胖、糖尿病或高心代谢风险成人。
population_en: Adults with obesity, diabetes, or high cardiometabolic risk.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: GLP-1 受体激动剂或相关肠促胰素药物治疗。
intervention_or_exposure_en: GLP-1 receptor agonists or related incretin-based pharmacotherapy.
comparator_zh: 安慰剂、常规照护或其他体重/心代谢管理。
comparator_en: Placebo, usual care, or alternative weight/cardiometabolic management.
outcomes_zh: 体重、血糖、心血管事件、不良反应。
outcomes_en: Weight, glycemic outcomes, cardiovascular events, adverse events.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; large RCT; large prospective cohort; Mendelian randomization where appropriate
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 这是处方药医学主题，不能被包装成普通抗衰或美容减肥建议。

population_zh: 没有禁忌证的成人。
population_en: Adults without contraindications to dietary energy restriction.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 营养充足前提下的适度热量限制。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Moderate caloric restriction with adequate nutrition.
comparator_zh: 自由进食或常规饮食。
comparator_en: Ad libitum diet or usual diet.
outcomes_zh: 体重、心代谢指标、衰老 biomarker、安全性。
outcomes_en: Weight, cardiometabolic markers, aging biomarkers, safety.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; RCT; prospective cohort; high-quality mechanistic bridge only as support
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能鼓励极端节食；孕期、进食障碍、慢病和高龄人群需谨慎。

population_zh: 有或无心代谢风险的成人。
population_en: Adults with or without cardiometabolic risk.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 限时进食或间歇性禁食窗口。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Time-restricted eating or intermittent fasting windows.
comparator_zh: 常规进食时间或连续热量限制。
comparator_en: Usual eating timing or continuous energy restriction.
outcomes_zh: 体重、血糖、血脂、血压、依从性和安全性。
outcomes_en: Weight, glycemic markers, lipids, blood pressure, adherence and safety.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; RCT; prospective cohort; high-quality mechanistic bridge only as support
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 糖尿病用药、孕期、进食障碍和低体重人群不应自行尝试。

population_zh: 糖尿病成人或被纳入衰老假说研究的人群。
population_en: Adults with diabetes or populations studied for aging-related hypotheses.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 二甲双胍暴露或治疗。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Metformin exposure or metformin treatment.
comparator_zh: 未使用二甲双胍、安慰剂或其他糖尿病治疗。
comparator_en: No metformin, placebo, or alternative diabetes treatment.
outcomes_zh: 糖尿病结局、心血管结局、癌症信号、衰老相关复合结局。
outcomes_en: Diabetes outcomes, cardiovascular outcomes, cancer signals, aging-related composite outcomes.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; RCT; prospective cohort; high-quality mechanistic bridge only as support
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把它写成普通人抗衰处方；肾功能、B12 和用药风险需医生评估。

population_zh: 动物模型和有限人体转化场景。
population_en: Animal models and limited human translational contexts.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 雷帕霉素、rapalog 或 mTOR 调节。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Rapamycin, rapalogs, or mTOR modulation.
comparator_zh: 安慰剂、未处理对照或其他机制干预。
comparator_en: Placebo, untreated control, or other mechanistic intervention.
outcomes_zh: 动物寿命、免疫/皮肤/代谢指标、不良反应。
outcomes_en: Lifespan in animals, immune/skin/metabolic markers, adverse events.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能建议健康人自行使用免疫抑制相关药物。

population_zh: 临床前模型和有限早期人体研究。
population_en: Preclinical models and limited early human studies.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: senolytic 候选药物或靶向细胞衰老干预。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Senolytic candidates or senescence-targeting interventions.
comparator_zh: 安慰剂、未处理对照或标准照护。
comparator_en: Placebo, untreated controls, or standard care.
outcomes_zh: 衰老细胞标志物、疾病特异终点、安全性。
outcomes_en: Senescence markers, disease-specific endpoints, safety.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能鼓励自行服用 dasatinib、quercetin、fisetin 等高剂量组合。

population_zh: NAD 生物学相关成人研究和临床前模型。
population_en: Adults and preclinical models studied for NAD biology.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: NMN、NR、NAD 前体或 NAD 调节干预。
intervention_or_exposure_en: NMN, NR, NAD precursors, or NAD-modulating interventions.
comparator_zh: 安慰剂或不补充。
comparator_en: Placebo or no supplementation.
outcomes_zh: NAD 代谢物、代谢指标、身体功能、安全性。
outcomes_en: NAD metabolites, metabolic markers, physical function, safety.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把提升 NAD 指标直接等同于延寿或抗衰成功。

population_zh: 人体队列、干预研究和 biomarker 验证数据集。
population_en: Human cohorts, intervention studies, and biomarker validation sets.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 表观遗传时钟测量或相关干预。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Measurement or modification of epigenetic clock biomarkers.
comparator_zh: 不同表观时钟、基线或对照组。
comparator_en: Different clock measures, baseline, or control groups.
outcomes_zh: 时钟年龄、疾病风险预测、死亡预测、对干预的响应。
outcomes_en: Clock age, disease risk prediction, mortality prediction, responsiveness to interventions.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; RCT; prospective cohort; high-quality mechanistic bridge only as support
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把时钟变年轻直接写成真正逆龄或延寿。

population_zh: ITP 小鼠模型和相关寿命实验。
population_en: Mouse models in the Interventions Testing Program and related lifespan studies.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 小鼠寿命候选干预。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Candidate lifespan interventions tested in mice.
comparator_zh: 对照饲料或未处理小鼠组。
comparator_en: Control diet or untreated mouse groups.
outcomes_zh: 小鼠寿命、健康寿命代理指标、性别差异。
outcomes_en: Mouse lifespan, healthspan proxies, sex-specific effects.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把小鼠寿命延长写成人类可用抗衰方案。

population_zh: 临床前模型和早期转化研究。
population_en: Preclinical models and early translational studies.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: Klotho 调节、IL-11 抑制或相关通路干预。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Klotho modulation, IL-11 inhibition, or related pathway interventions.
comparator_zh: 未处理对照、野生型对照或安慰剂。
comparator_en: Untreated controls, wild-type controls, or placebo.
outcomes_zh: 机制性衰老标志物、疾病模型、寿命/健康寿命代理指标。
outcomes_en: Mechanistic aging markers, disease models, lifespan/healthspan proxies.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能写成可自行应用的人体抗衰治疗。

population_zh: 细胞、动物模型和早期技术平台。
population_en: Cells, animal models, and early technology platforms.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 部分细胞重编程或 Yamanaka 因子相关方法。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Partial cellular reprogramming or Yamanaka-factor-related approaches.
comparator_zh: 未处理或假处理对照。
comparator_en: Untreated or sham controls.
outcomes_zh: 细胞标志物、模型组织功能、安全性和肿瘤风险信号。
outcomes_en: Cellular markers, tissue function in models, safety and tumorigenicity signals.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把实验室 rejuvenation 写成人体可用疗法。

population_zh: 临床前模型和人体 biomarker/干预研究。
population_en: Preclinical models and human biomarker/intervention studies.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 自噬或线粒体自噬调节干预。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Autophagy or mitophagy-modulating interventions.
comparator_zh: 对照条件、安慰剂或常规照护。
comparator_en: Control condition, placebo, or usual care.
outcomes_zh: 机制指标、代谢/功能指标、疾病特异结局。
outcomes_en: Mechanistic markers, metabolic/functional markers, disease-specific outcomes.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把激活自噬宣传成普遍延寿或排毒。

title_zh: 微生物组与炎症性衰老
population_zh: 人体队列、临床疾病人群和临床前微生物组模型。
population_en: Human cohorts, clinical conditions, and preclinical microbiome models.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 微生物组组成、饮食、益生元/益生菌或靶向微生物组干预。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Microbiome composition, diet, probiotics/prebiotics, or microbiome-targeted interventions.
comparator_zh: 不同微生物组特征、安慰剂、常规饮食或对照组。
comparator_en: Different microbiome profiles, placebo, usual diet, or control groups.
outcomes_zh: 炎症、代谢结局、免疫指标、疾病风险、衰弱。
outcomes_en: Inflammation, metabolic outcomes, immune markers, disease risk, frailty.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; RCT; prospective cohort; high-quality mechanistic bridge only as support
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把单一益生菌写成抗衰处方。

population_zh: 存在紫外线或可见光相关光老化风险的人群。
population_en: People exposed to ultraviolet or visible-light-related photoaging risk.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 广谱防晒和综合光防护。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Broad-spectrum sunscreen and photoprotection.
comparator_zh: 不规律、不充分或无光防护。
comparator_en: Discretionary, inadequate, or no photoprotection.
outcomes_zh: 光老化、色素、皱纹、红斑、DNA 损伤。
outcomes_en: Photoaging, pigmentation, wrinkles, erythema, DNA damage.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; large RCT; large prospective cohort; Mendelian randomization where appropriate
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不代表逆转所有已存在皮肤老化，也不代表某个具体产品优于其他产品。

title_zh: 维A酸/视黄醇类与光老化
population_zh: 有光老化表现或皮肤美容诉求的成人。
population_en: Adults with photoaging signs or cosmetic dermatology concerns.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 外用维A酸、视黄醇、视黄醛等。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Topical retinoids, tretinoin, retinol, retinaldehyde.
comparator_zh: 基质、安慰剂、常规护肤或较弱配方。
comparator_en: Vehicle, placebo, usual skincare, or lower-strength formulations.
outcomes_zh: 皱纹、肤质、色素、胶原相关指标、刺激反应。
outcomes_en: Wrinkles, texture, pigmentation, collagen-related markers, irritation.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; RCT; prospective cohort; high-quality mechanistic bridge only as support
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 处方维A酸、孕期、敏感肌和皮肤病人群需要医生评估。

title_zh: 烟酰胺与屏障/色素/炎症
title_en: Niacinamide for Barrier, Pigment, and Inflammation
population_zh: 有屏障、色素、炎症、痤疮或皮肤美容诉求的人群。
population_en: People with barrier, pigment, inflammation, acne, or cosmetic skin concerns.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 按具体问题区分外用或口服烟酰胺/烟酰胺类。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Topical or oral niacinamide/nicotinamide depending on claim.
comparator_zh: 基质、安慰剂、常规护肤或不处理。
comparator_en: Vehicle, placebo, usual skincare, or no treatment.
outcomes_zh: 屏障功能、色素、炎症、痤疮、耐受性。
outcomes_en: Barrier function, pigmentation, inflammation, acne, tolerability.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能宣传为全身抗衰或延寿。

population_zh: 有光老化、色素或抗氧化护肤诉求的人群。
population_en: People with photoaging, pigment, or antioxidant skincare concerns.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 外用维C或抗坏血酸配方。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Topical vitamin C or ascorbic-acid formulations.
comparator_zh: 基质、安慰剂、常规护肤或其他活性成分。
comparator_en: Vehicle, placebo, usual skincare, or other active ingredients.
outcomes_zh: 色素、胶原指标、光老化表现、刺激和稳定性。
outcomes_en: Pigmentation, collagen markers, photoaging signs, irritation and stability.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; RCT; prospective cohort; high-quality mechanistic bridge only as support
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能替代防晒、医美或疾病治疗。

title_zh: 口服胶原肽与皮肤弹性/水分
population_zh: 以皮肤外观终点为目标使用口服胶原肽的成人。
population_en: Adults using oral collagen peptides for skin appearance endpoints.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 口服胶原肽或水解胶原。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Oral collagen peptides or hydrolyzed collagen.
comparator_zh: 安慰剂或不补充。
comparator_en: Placebo or no supplementation.
outcomes_zh: 水分、弹性、皱纹、主观外观、不良反应。
outcomes_en: Hydration, elasticity, wrinkles, patient-reported appearance, adverse effects.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能写成逆龄、延寿或替代均衡蛋白摄入。

title_zh: 透明质酸、神经酰胺与皮肤水分屏障
population_zh: 皮肤干燥、屏障受损或保湿诉求人群。
population_en: People with dry skin, impaired barrier, or hydration concerns.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 外用或口服透明质酸、神经酰胺或屏障支持配方。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Topical or oral hyaluronic acid, ceramides, or barrier-supporting formulations.
comparator_zh: 基质、安慰剂、常规保湿或不干预。
comparator_en: Vehicle, placebo, usual moisturizer, or no intervention.
outcomes_zh: 皮肤水分、经皮水分流失、屏障功能、干燥。
outcomes_en: Skin hydration, transepidermal water loss, barrier function, dryness.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能宣传为系统性抗衰或替代皮肤病治疗。

title_zh: 多酚/抗氧化剂与皮肤光保护
population_zh: 以皮肤光保护为目标使用多酚或抗氧化剂的人群。
population_en: People using polyphenols or antioxidants for skin photoprotection claims.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 多酚、抗氧化剂、类胡萝卜素、植物提取物。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Polyphenols, antioxidants, carotenoids, botanical extracts.
comparator_zh: 安慰剂、基质、常规饮食/护肤或不补充。
comparator_en: Placebo, vehicle, usual diet/skincare, or no supplementation.
outcomes_zh: 光保护指标、红斑、色素、氧化应激指标。
outcomes_en: Photoprotection markers, erythema, pigmentation, oxidative-stress markers.
preferred_study_designs: human pilot studies plus mechanistic/preclinical evidence, clearly separated from public claims
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能替代防晒，也不能把抗氧化机制写成抗老已证实。

title_zh: 医美能量设备和换肤类干预
population_zh: 因光老化、皱纹、瘢痕或肤质问题考虑医美操作的人群。
population_en: People seeking procedural treatment for photoaging, wrinkles, scars, or texture concerns.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: 激光、强脉冲光、微针、换肤和 resurfacing 设备。
intervention_or_exposure_en: Laser, intense pulsed light, microneedling, peels, resurfacing devices.
comparator_zh: 假处理、常规护理、其他设备或基线。
comparator_en: Sham, usual care, other devices, or baseline.
outcomes_zh: 皱纹、肤质、色素、瘢痕、不良反应、恢复期。
outcomes_en: Wrinkles, texture, pigmentation, scars, adverse events, downtime.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; RCT; prospective cohort; high-quality mechanistic bridge only as support
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 必须由合格专业人员评估；不能提供参数、疗程或设备推荐。

population_zh: 考虑外用、导入、注射或填充类 PDRN/PN / skin booster 宣传的人群。
population_en: People considering topical, device-assisted, injectable, or filler-like PDRN/PN skin-booster claims.
intervention_or_exposure_zh: PDRN、polynucleotide、PN 或 skin booster 产品/操作，并按外用、导入、注射、填充等路径分开。
intervention_or_exposure_en: PDRN, polynucleotide, PN, or skin-booster products and procedures, separated by route and procedure type.
comparator_zh: 基质、安慰剂、常规护肤、无操作或其他专业医美操作。
comparator_en: Vehicle, placebo, usual skincare, no procedure, or alternative professional procedures.
outcomes_zh: 皮肤修复、皱纹、弹性、瘢痕/创面、操作相关不良反应和效果持续时间。
outcomes_en: Skin repair, wrinkles, elasticity, scars/wounds, procedure-related adverse events, and durability.
preferred_study_designs: systematic review/meta-analysis; RCT; prospective cohort; high-quality mechanistic bridge only as support
exclusion_or_boundary_zh: 不能把外用化妆品证据当作注射项目证据，也不能写成逆龄、延寿或无风险医美项目。
